== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 19 November 2020. The Facebook photo viewer names Shin Okada. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 70 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Tokyo, Jap). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/Shin.Okada.Emma. The uncropped original is a restaurant photograph with a second person partly visible behind Okada; the lead crop is Okada alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Shin Okada portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Shin Okada Facebook portrait.jpg]].
